Title:MOTION OF NO CONFIDENCE
MPs Speaking:Dr Goh Keng Swee (Minister for Finance); Dr Toh Chin Chye (Deputy Prime Minister and Leader of the House); Mr Chan Chee Seng (Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs); Mr G. Kandasamy (Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture); Mr K. M. Byrne (Minister for Health and Law); Mr Lee Kuan Yew (Prime Minister); Mr Ong Pang Boon (Minister for Home Affairs); Mr Yong Nyuk Lin (Minister for Education); Dato Abdul Hamid Bin Haji Jumat; Dr Lee Siew Choh; Inche Ahmad Jabri Bin Mohammad Akib; Inche Mohd. Ali Bin Alwi; Mr A. P. Rajah; Mr David Marshall; Mr Ong Eng Guan; Mr S. T. Bani; Mrs Seow Peck Leng; Tun Lim Yew Hock; Mr John Mammen (Deputy Speaker); Sir George Oehlers (Mr Speaker);


Column: 484

MOTION OF NO CONFIDENCE


    Mr Speaker: Order. The guillotine has fallen on that very pleasant note.

    Original Question put, "That this House expresses no confidence in the Government."

    The Prime Minister: Division.

    The House divided: Ayes, 16; Noes, 24; Absent, 3; Abstentions, 8.
